skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge of educational management to analyze, evaluate, and propose solutions for practical situations in educational system management.
Apply knowledge of educational management to analyze, evaluate, and propose solutions for educational policy situations.
Apply knowledge of educational management to analyze, evaluate, and solve practical issues in educational management.
Demonstrate effective communication and presentation skills.
Demonstrate effective negotiation, teamwork, and time management skills.
Use economic and social research methods to analyze policy issues, educational management, and decision-making.
Analyze, advise, critique, plan, organize, monitor, and evaluate educational policies, programs, and projects.
Demonstrate the ability to work independently or in a team under changing conditions and evaluate the effectiveness of activities.
Develop the ability to learn independently and adapt to changes.
Demonstrate a spirit of service, social responsibility, and professional ethics.
